craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 42. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Downward-faced always to be placed; worshipped in worship again, that
vessel upward-faced; and that empty should make not, such.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam
